name: Doogh
description: Salted yogurt drink with dried mint, often sparkling.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; drunk with kabab for exactly that reason.

effects.note: Doogh is yogurt itself, thinned with water and salted, carrying the same live cultures credited with yogurt's own lactose-digestion effect — untested directly, but not a different food from the yogurt the trials used, just a savoury, more dilute serving of it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
